Exclusive breastfeeding for 3 months or more
Growth profiles based on ponderal index
cohort: 609 children born to women with BMI greater than or equal to 30 and/or prior gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) (2008-2013), with 332 children attending the 5-year follow-up (2014-2017)
finding: Accelerated early growth was associated with higher adiposity in 5-year-old children from high-risk pregnancies, even when adjusted for lifestyle.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with higher odds of ascending growth, while exclusive breastfeeding for 3 months or more was associated with lower odds of ascending growth.
